svg.title: Missing phase labels
svg.desc: Two windows. In the first, the S arrival was read but the P arrival was not, although it is in the waveform: the stretch where the P can arrive, from max_sp_s before the S up to 3 sigma before it, is masked. In the second, P was read and S was not: the stretch from 3 sigma after the P up to max_sp_s after it is masked. The loss ignores every channel in the mask; the metrics ignore that phase's peaks there.
